## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 19 mai 2026 - 27 juil. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _rybu0305_, 25 juil. 2026, 1/5: "They removed the ability to easily see the month from the top view and then switch to the schedule view. App is unusable now."
            2. _Heatmiser NeoApp_, 22 mai 2026, 1/5: "Apple app icon shows 31st. Should be showing the correct date! Bug only affects Apple devices and not Android"
            3. _Mumakil_, 11 juin 2026, 3/5: "It’s not bad but a few changes would get it more stars. The main issues I have are in adding an entry. Why do I have to scroll through months to get to the date I want? Drop downs to select the month and year for things way in the future would be much better. Also occasionally it freezes the keyboard when I try to enter a location. This is the only app I have that freezes anytime I’m entering information so clearly a bug in the app. Lastly why does the app icon show 31 and not the current date like the iOS calendar app does?"
